topic: The word SET — 4 completely different meanings that will blow your mind
target_audience: intermediate to advanced English learners, vocabulary builders aged 16-40
hook_options: One English word. Four completely different meanings. Most learners only know one.
This single word has more meanings than almost any other word in the English language.
You use this word every day and you don't even know what it really means.
script_sentences: One tiny word. Four completely different meanings.
Meaning one: to place something. Set the cup on the table.
Meaning two: a group of things. A set of keys.
Meaning three: when the sun goes down. The sun sets at seven.
Meaning four: ready to go. Are you all set?
One word. Four worlds. You just leveled up.
Save this — your vocabulary just exploded.

titles: The word SET explained in 45 seconds
Why SET is the most powerful word in English
packaging.description: The word SET has over 430 definitions in the Oxford English Dictionary — more than any other verb. Today we cover the 4 you need to know to sound naturally fluent. Level up your English vocabulary fast with this one short.

scenes.voice_line: One tiny English word. Four completely different meanings. Most learners only know one.
Meaning one: to place something. Set the cup on the table. Set your phone down. Set the record straight.

meaning_card.label: PLACE
meaning_card.example_sentence: Set the cup on the table.

sfx_prompts: gentle thud place object sound effect

scenes.voice_line: Meaning two: a group of things that belong together. A set of keys. A set of rules. A chess set. A matching set.

scenes.text: Meaning 3: when the sun goes DOWN
scenes.voice_line: Meaning three: when the sun goes down. The sun sets at seven. It sets in the west. Beautiful sunset.
sfx_prompts: peaceful nature ambient brief sound effect
scenes.image_prompt: Minimalist dark neon illustration of a sunset scene. Stickman figure silhouetted against an orange-red glowing horizon. The word SETS glows in neon letters in the sky. Dark purple sky, neon orange sun half-set on horizon. Clean, stylized, digital art style.

scenes.voice_line: Meaning four: ready to go. Are you all set? We are set to launch. Get set! This one you hear every single day.

Now listen to this one sentence that uses all four meanings. She set her alarm — that is place — for the full set — that is group — of sunrise photos as the sun set — that is sunset — because she was all set — that is ready — to go.

mini_story.sentence: She set her alarm for the full set of sunrise photos as the sun set — because she was all set to go.
